title: Federal Sentencing Guidelines (Hướng dẫn Lượng hình Liên bang)
typeLabel: Quy định / Văn bản dưới luật

versions.text:
Federal Sentencing Guidelines Manual (USSG).
Chapter 1: Introduction and general application principles.
Chapter 2: Offense conduct. Part A: Offenses against the person. Part B: Basic economic offenses. Part D: Offenses involving drugs. Part J: Offenses involving immigration.
Chapter 3: Adjustments. Acceptance of responsibility. Role in the offense.
Chapter 4: Criminal history and criminal livelihood.
Chapter 5: Determining the sentence. Sentencing table (offense level × criminal history category).
